docx-to-markdown.html.description: Microsoft MarkItDown and AILANG Parse both convert Word (DOCX) files to Markdown for RAG and LLMs. AILANG Parse also keeps comments, tracked changes, nested lists and merged cells. On {ailang_parse.per_format.docx.files} open test files it scores {ailang_parse.per_format.docx.composite}; MarkItDown scores {markitdown.per_format.docx.composite}. Local, no GPU, no AI model.
